about: The historical A/B replay (LIMITATIONS_FIXES_V4 13.7 trap 6) and evolve.py's held-out benchmark: ten real owner asks that ended at 3/10 or below (or were stopped), each with the words a compiled prompt MUST carry to have prevented that failure. A raw_prompt marked 'reconstructed' is rebuilt from the card or verdict that records the ask (no verbatim message survives). Sample Game and anything with blood are left out. Never edit a must_contain to make a replay pass: fix the template or the grounding. Each case also names its own graveyard record (graveyard): the compiled prompt must carry that record, retrieved from the owner's words (prompt-specific grounding, not only the lane template). anim-craft-set has none: nothing in its words links it to the key-poses record; the from-scratch invariant carries it.

cases.raw_prompt: Build Hollow Purple (the attack from Jujutsu Kaisen) as a VFX effect.
cases.failure: built from lore text and memory with no scene frames: 'look really bad'

cases.raw_prompt: Make the Delaware Smash effect original - the owner rejected v1 as looking too much like the last showpiece, so give it a different look.
cases.failure: originality read as a genre swap (a comic-book print): 'trash'

cases.raw_prompt: Phase 2 of Mission 02 VFX: build a proof effect in Roblox Studio with an animated R6 character presenting the effect in a booth.
cases.failure: made and judged in Studio on an animated rig: 'stop making vfx in roblox studio ... horrendous'
cases.graveyard: making + judging effects in roblox studio

cases.raw_prompt: Build a complete brawler/boxing combat moveset for the kit: jab, cross, hook, uppercut, slip, block, hit reaction, idle, and combo chains.
cases.failure: moves assembled from 8 eased key poses: 'genuinely horrible, 3/10 at best'

cases.raw_prompt: Build a running animation for the R6 rig, matching the angle numbers from the owner-loved reference sprint animation exactly.
cases.failure: matched every angle number of the reference: 'genuinely horrible'

cases.raw_prompt: Build a dragon sword weapon 3D model - a sword with a dragon head hilt.
cases.failure: a dragon figure typed from SDF primitives with no checked reference: 'WEIRD AND UGLY'

cases.raw_prompt: Improve the starter props (crate, chest, blaster) to score higher, lifting them past the prop quality bar.
cases.failure: detail added to move a gate score: graded 1/100

cases.raw_prompt: Build the terrain for SampleRegion (an Elden Ring-style region) using the procedural terrain generator.
cases.failure: noise and thermal erosion alone: 'the quality of the terrain is horrid'

cases.raw_prompt: Build as many showcase worlds as possible for Mission 05 to demonstrate world building quality improvement.
cases.failure: five worlds for breadth: 'the main idea of the mission was to improve quality'

cases.raw_prompt: Build a character-action style in-game HUD.
cases.failure: typed glyphs, flat tints and PIL rectangles with no references: 'GENUINE AI SLOP'
